block_row: Structural top: ports, interconnect and named instances only.

frame_row: Structural top of the asynchronous four-phase handshake IP.

label: u_src
(m_vlsit_ahs4_src)
blocks.function: Source request and completion flags, payload register, acknowledge synchronizer instance.

label: u_dst
(m_vlsit_ahs4_dst)
blocks.function: Request synchronizer instance; transparent (mode 0) or captured (mode 1) data and acknowledge path.

interfaces.name: Source request interface (requester side)
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_req, i_data; TOP -> u_src: i_req, i_data

interfaces.name: Source completion interface (requester side)
interfaces.signals: u_src -> TOP: o_ack; TOP -> external: o_ack

interfaces.name: Request and payload crossing, CDC-001 and CDC-003
Destination request interface (completer side)
interfaces.signals: u_dst -> TOP: o_req, o_data; TOP -> external: o_req, o_data

interfaces.name: Destination acknowledge input and acknowledge crossing, CDC-002
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_ack; TOP -> u_dst: i_ack; u_dst -> u_src: w_ack

interfaces.name: Source clock and reset
interfaces.signals: SoC -> TOP: i_clk_src, i_rst_n_src; TOP -> u_src: i_clk_src, i_rst_n_src

interfaces.name: Destination clock and reset
interfaces.signals: SoC -> TOP: i_clk_dst, i_rst_n_dst; TOP -> u_dst: i_clk_dst, i_rst_n_dst

legend_note: The enclosing frame is the top module; the two blocks are its instances. The synchronizer instances u_sync_ack and u_sync_req are inside u_src and u_dst respectively. i_ack enters u_dst; in mode 0 it passes through, in mode 1 it is registered, and in both modes u_dst returns the acknowledge to u_src as the internal net w_ack listed in the DACK row of the interface table.
